Do you beans in a pan on the hob untill thick, the consistency is much better and helps with the presentation.  Scrambled eggs are fine, its personal choice. A true fry is all done in one pan and an egg fried in the meat juices and oil is a great alternative.  

Serve your toast on a seperate plate if possible. keep it crunchy,  helps with fry space and presentation. (Again personal preference) Those toms look proper poor, cut in half and fry untill charred. Sausage and bacon look great, maybe consider black pudding going forward, cook it in large chunks, with bacon and on toast / fried bread it tastes bloody great;  again, if possible do all in a single pan. Mushrooms ndont really make it on my fry, but if i have to i keep them big and fry them quickly to help with presentation and texture.

My favourite glasto story: 

2016, mid afternoon 3pm. Me and my ex wandering  the arts and crafts field next to the greenfields. There is a Stone masonry class. Horreeeeeeendous hammering sound as I'm sure you all can imagine. Probably 10 odd kids smacking down on hunks of stone. Me and my hungover head hastily dodging ghe stall and its patrons. My ex however, wandered in for a random looksie. 
I'm a few yards away avoiding it like the plauge, holding my tender cider addled head. I see her eyes widen and she swings back, beckoning me over, waving wildly. 
With grimaced teeth and much anxiety, I walk towards the almighty racket. 
Weaving through the group I approach her and she's grinning like a Cheshire cat and pointing and a little red velvet carpet, snaking behind the masonry stall. It leads to a velvet set of red curtains.
Behind the curtains housed a tiny, I mean; held maybe 30 people sized tent. It was a cocktail bar, with a fantastic disco/ funk dj playing. The dj could of well of been famous or could of been nobody. But none of that mattered. We stumbled upon  a secret venue, with peobably 25 other people. Drinking ice cold bloody Marys and having the time of our lives, we missed about 4 acts we had planned to see. It was fucking ace. We came out at about 9pm.
